item.title: Local AI API: Image-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, and LLM APIs
item.description: A practical collection of Python Flask API implementations for running various AI models locally, including image-to-text using Moondream, text-to-speech with Coqui TTS, and text generation via local LLMs with OpenAI-compatible interfaces.

item.title: Setting Up a Local Large Language Model (LLM) Environment
item.description: A guide to setting up a local large language model (LLM) environment for TheraFit, a project focused on matching clients with therapists.
